comment: Professor Mullen is great. He is honest and give direct feedback to presentations. He is a kind person and his course incorporates several opportunities to revise and improve your grade. Easy to get an A if you are focused and respond to feedback. Class is also short, often leaving a little early.

Very to the point teacher. Some of his instructions were quite vauge, but he is a pretty easy grader so long as you actuall complete the assignment. Allows redos for most assignments. Usually ends class 20 minutes early. Three group projects, but the latter two are pretty easy. He won't be your favorite teacher, but is a good way to get the credit.

Mullen is fine if you're trying to get the BComm credit. He does try to make the class more interesting by bringing in his personal life but rambles on for too long. His group projects are pretty insufferable and is nitpicky on every little detail. He does let you out of class early most of the time though, which is a plus.

DO NOT TAKE HIM! he is the rudest professor I had at UR, he would say things bluntly during presentations. doesn't understand student circumstances and doesn't accommodate them, he's a fine teacher. But I didn't like him there are other better professors to take
Loves to ramble, also not the nicest person. Doesn't seem to know what he's talking about most of the time. However, not the hardest class.
He is a good teacher, and the grades you receive are fair.

The class is very doable. The team presentations and independent writing assignments are a big part of your grade. If you put the necessary time into these, an A is very achievable. He also never keeps track of who does WSJs.
